note: A short phrase used to advertise or summarize something; also the final line of a joke or the label attached to a graphic.

senses.m: A short phrase used to advertise or summarize something
senses.pat: a memorable tag line · advertising tag line · tag line for a campaign
ex: The film’s tag line appeared on the poster.
Câu quảng cáo của bộ phim xuất hiện trên áp phích.
The company tested several tag lines for the launch.
Công ty thử nghiệm một số câu khẩu hiệu cho đợt ra mắt.

note: A small steam locomotive with water tanks mounted on the engine rather than a separate tender.

senses.m: A small steam locomotive with water tanks mounted on the engine rather than a separate tender
senses.pat: a steam tank engine · tank-engine driver · operate a tank engine
ex: The heritage railway runs a restored tank engine.

The tank engine is suited to short branch lines.
Đầu máy có thùng nước liền thân phù hợp với các tuyến nhánh ngắn.

note: A sleeveless shirt, usually with shoulder straps; also called a vest in British English in some contexts.

senses.m: A sleeveless shirt, usually with shoulder straps
senses.pat: wear a tank top · a cotton tank top · sleeveless tank top
ex: He wore a tank top during the workout.
Anh mặc áo ba lỗ khi tập luyện.
The store sells tank tops in several colors.
Cửa hàng bán áo ba lỗ với nhiều màu.

note: A dancer who performs tap dancing, making rhythmic sounds with metal plates on the shoes.

senses.m: A dancer who performs tap dancing, making rhythmic sounds with metal plates on the shoes
senses.pat: a professional tap dancer · become a tap dancer · tap-dancer routine
ex: The tap dancer performed a fast solo.
Vũ công nhảy tap biểu diễn một màn độc diễn nhanh.
She trained as a tap dancer from childhood.
Cô được đào tạo nhảy tap từ nhỏ.

note: A dance style in which dancers create rhythmic sounds with their shoes, usually fitted with metal taps.

senses.m: A dance style in which dancers create rhythmic sounds with their shoes, usually fitted with metal taps
senses.pat: learn/go tap dancing · tap-dancing class · tap-dance routine
ex: He takes tap dancing lessons twice a week.
Anh học nhảy tap hai lần mỗi tuần.
The show included a lively tap-dancing number.
Chương trình có tiết mục nhảy tap sôi động.

note: Water supplied through household or public pipes, as opposed to bottled water; quality and treatment vary by location.

senses.m: Water supplied through household or public pipes, as opposed to bottled water
senses.pat: drink tap water · run the tap water · tap-water quality
ex: The restaurant serves filtered tap water.
Nhà hàng phục vụ nước máy đã lọc.
Check local guidance on whether tap water is safe to drink.
Hãy kiểm tra hướng dẫn địa phương xem nước máy có an toàn để uống không.

note: A person paid to dance with customers at a dance hall, often by the dance; historical term.

senses.m: A person paid to dance with customers at a dance hall, often by the dance
senses.pat: work as a taxi dancer · a taxi-dance hall · hire a taxi dancer

Bộ phim khắc họa một vũ công được trả tiền nhảy cùng khách tại vũ trường thập niên 1930.
The historical article explains how taxi dancers were paid by the dance.
Bài viết lịch sử giải thích cách các vũ công này được trả tiền theo lượt nhảy.

note: A person who drives a taxi to transport passengers for a fare.

senses.m: A person who drives a taxi to transport passengers for a fare
senses.pat: work as a taxi driver · hail a taxi driver · taxi-driver license
ex: The taxi driver took the passengers to the airport.
Tài xế taxi chở hành khách đến sân bay.
She works as a taxi driver on weekends.
Cô làm tài xế taxi vào cuối tuần.

note: A cloth used to dry dishes or cover food; British English. US English often dish towel.

senses.m: A cloth used to dry dishes or cover food
senses.pat: dry dishes with a tea towel · a clean tea towel · tea-towel fabric
ex: He dried the glasses with a tea towel.
Anh lau khô ly bằng khăn lau bát đĩa.
Cover the dough with a clean tea towel.
Đậy bột bằng khăn sạch.

note: To remove something forcefully; also tear oneself away means reluctantly stop doing or leave something enjoyable.

senses.m: To remove something forcefully
senses.pat: tear away a label · tear oneself away from a book · be torn away
ex: She tore away the old wallpaper.
Cô xé lớp giấy dán tường cũ ra.
He could not tear himself away from the game.
Anh không thể rời mắt khỏi trận đấu.

note: To demolish a building or structure; figuratively, to criticize or dismantle an argument or system.

senses.m: To demolish a building or structure
senses.pat: tear down a building · tear down an argument · be torn down
ex: The city plans to tear down the unsafe bridge.
Thành phố dự định phá bỏ cây cầu không an toàn.
The critic tore down the proposal point by point.
Nhà phê bình bác bỏ đề xuất từng điểm một.

note: A chemical irritant that causes eye and respiratory irritation; used by law enforcement or military forces, with serious risks especially in enclosed spaces.

senses.m: A chemical irritant that causes eye and respiratory irritation
senses.pat: deploy/use tear gas · tear-gas canister · exposure to tear gas
ex: Police used tear gas to disperse the crowd.
Cảnh sát dùng hơi cay để giải tán đám đông.
Medical teams treated people exposed to tear gas.
Đội y tế điều trị những người phơi nhiễm hơi cay.

note: A soft toy bear, named after US President Theodore Roosevelt; also a term of affection for a large, gentle person.

senses.m: A soft toy bear, named after US President Theodore Roosevelt
senses.pat: a stuffed teddy bear · cuddle a teddy bear · teddy-bear toy
ex: The child took a teddy bear to bed.
Đứa trẻ mang gấu bông đi ngủ.
He gave her a teddy bear as a keepsake.
Anh tặng cô một con gấu bông làm kỷ vật.

note: A rectangular playing area for tennis, marked with lines and divided by a net.

senses.m: A rectangular playing area for tennis, marked with lines and divided by a net
senses.pat: play on a tennis court · a hard-court tennis court · tennis-court surface
ex: They booked a tennis court for the afternoon.
Họ đặt sân tennis vào buổi chiều.
The tennis court was resurfaced last year.
Mặt sân tennis được làm lại vào năm ngoái.

note: A pilot who flies experimental or modified aircraft to evaluate performance and safety.

senses.m: A pilot who flies experimental or modified aircraft to evaluate performance and safety
senses.pat: work as a test pilot · a military test pilot · test-pilot program
ex: The test pilot evaluated the aircraft’s handling.
Phi công thử nghiệm đánh giá khả năng điều khiển của máy bay.
She became a test pilot after serving in the air force.
Cô trở thành phi công thử nghiệm sau khi phục vụ trong không quân.

note: A small cylindrical glass or plastic tube used in laboratory experiments.

senses.m: A small cylindrical glass or plastic tube used in laboratory experiments
senses.pat: a test tube of liquid · put a sample in a test tube · test-tube experiment
ex: The scientist placed the sample in a test tube.
Nhà khoa học đặt mẫu vào ống nghiệm.
The test tubes were labeled before the experiment.
Các ống nghiệm được dán nhãn trước thí nghiệm.

note: An organization that researches and develops ideas on policy or social issues; also metaphorically a group working intensively on a problem.

senses.m: An organization that researches and develops ideas on policy or social issues
senses.pat: a policy think tank · work for a think tank · think-tank report

Viện nghiên cứu chính sách công bố báo cáo về chính sách nhà ở.
The company formed a think tank to explore new designs.
Công ty lập một nhóm chuyên gia để tìm ý tưởng thiết kế mới.

note: A phrase meaning careful or creative thought, usually in put on your thinking cap.

senses.m: A phrase meaning careful or creative thought, usually in put on your thinking cap
senses.pat: put on your thinking cap · use one’s thinking cap · thinking-cap exercise
ex: Put on your thinking cap and solve the puzzle.
Hãy động não để giải câu đố.
The team put their thinking caps on before the workshop.
Cả nhóm động não trước buổi hội thảo.

note: Intense questioning by police or investigators; also the third or most severe degree in a classification, such as a burn, depending on context and law.

senses.m: Intense questioning by police or investigators
senses.pat: give someone the third degree · third-degree burn · charge with third-degree offense
ex: The detectives gave him the third degree about the missing files.
Các thám tử thẩm vấn dồn dập anh về những hồ sơ bị mất.
She was treated for a third-degree burn.
Cô được điều trị vết bỏng độ ba.

note: Three of four equal parts; also the musical interval spanning three diatonic scale steps in some contexts. Use hyphen when it is an adjective before a noun: three-quarter length.

senses.m: Three of four equal parts
senses.pat: three quarters of the cake · three-quarter time · three quarters full
ex: Three quarters of the class completed the assignment.
Ba phần tư lớp học hoàn thành bài tập.
The bottle was three quarters full.
Chai đầy ba phần tư.
